nm: Where Does a Tree's Mass Come From? · Biology

markers.cm: 01_1 · A tiny sapling grows into a big tree.
01_2 · Where did all that extra mass come from? Make a prediction.
01_3 · Most people guess the soil. Let's test it.
02_1 · First, weigh the dry soil and the sapling.
02_2 · This is the experiment Jan van Helmont ran in the 1640s.
03_2 · No soil is added. The tree only gets water.
04_2 · The tree gained 74.4 kilograms. The soil lost almost nothing.
04_3 · So the mass didn't come from the soil.
05_1 · Next, seal the plant in a box and take away carbon dioxide.
05_2 · Light and water, but no carbon dioxide. It doesn't grow.
06_2 · Light turns carbon dioxide and water into glucose.
06_3 · And glucose builds the tree's body. That's the 74.4 kilograms.
